If 'match', the server will maintain a 1:N ratio of humans to bots, where N is bot_quota.

entries.name: mp_backup_restore_list_files
entries.description: Lists recent backup round files matching the prefix, most recent files first, accepts a numeric parameter to limit the number of files displayed

entries.description: Loads player cash, KDA, scores and team scores; resets to the next round after the backup

entries.name: mp_bot_ai_bt
entries.description: Use the specified behavior tree file to drive the bot behavior.

entries.name: mp_bot_ai_bt_clear_cache
entries.description: Clears the cache for behavior tree files.

entries.name: mp_buy_allow_grenades
entries.description: Whether players can purchase grenades from the buy menu or not.

entries.name: mp_buy_allow_guns
entries.description: Whether players can purchase guns: pistols (1), SMGs (2), rifles (4), shotguns (8), sniper rifles (16), heavy MGs (32).

entries.name: mp_buy_anywhere
entries.description: When set, players can buy anywhere, not only in buyzones. 0 = default. 1 = both teams. 2 = Terrorists. 3 = Counter-Terrorists.

entries.name: mp_buy_during_immunity
entries.description: When set, players can buy when immune, ignoring buytime. 0 = default. 1 = both teams. 2 = Terrorists. 3 = Counter-Terrorists.

entries.name: mp_buytime
entries.description: How many seconds after round start players can buy items for.

entries.name: mp_c4_cannot_be_defused
entries.description: If set, the planted c4 cannot be defused.

entries.name: mp_c4timer
entries.description: how long from when the C4 is armed until it blows

entries.name: mp_chattime
entries.description: amount of time players can chat after the game is over

entries.name: mp_competitive_endofmatch_extra_time
entries.description: After a competitive match finishes rematch voting extra time is given for rankings.

entries.description: How loss streak is affected with round win: 0 = win fully resets loss bonus, 1 = first win steps down loss bonus, 2 = first win holds loss bonus and step down starting with second win

entries.name: mp_coopmission_bot_difficulty_offset
entries.description: The difficulty offset modifier for bots during coop missions.

entries.name: mp_ct_default_grenades
entries.description: The default grenades that the CTs will spawn with.	 To give multiple grenades, separate each weapon class with a space like this: 'weapon_molotov weapon_hegrenade'

entries.name: mp_ct_default_melee
entries.description: The default melee weapon that the CTs will spawn with.	 Even if this is blank, a knife will be given.	To give a taser, it should look like this: 'weapon_knife weapon_taser'.	 Remember to set mp_weapons_allow_zeus to 1 if you want to give a taser!

entries.name: mp_ct_default_primary
entries.description: The default primary (rifle) weapon that the CTs will spawn with

entries.name: mp_ct_default_secondary
entries.description: The default secondary (pistol) weapon that the CTs will spawn with

entries.name: mp_damage_headshot_only
entries.description: Determines whether non-headshot hits do any damage.

entries.name: mp_damage_scale_ct_body
entries.description: Scales the damage a CT player takes by this much when they take damage in the body. (1 == 100%, 0.5 == 50%)

entries.description: Scales the damage a CT player takes by this much when they take damage in the head (1 == 100%, 0.5 == 50%).  REMEMBER! headshots do 4x the damage of the body before this scaler is applied.

entries.name: mp_damage_scale_t_body
entries.description: Scales the damage a T player takes by this much when they take damage in the body. (1 == 100%, 0.5 == 50%)

entries.name: mp_damage_scale_t_head
entries.description: Scales the damage a T player takes by this much when they take damage in the head (1 == 100%, 0.5 == 50%).	 REMEMBER! headshots do 4x the damage of the body before this scaler is applied.

entries.name: mp_damage_vampiric_amount
entries.description: If Set to non-0, will determine the fraction of damage dealt that will be given to attacker.

entries.name: mp_death_drop_c4
entries.description: Whether c4 is droppable

entries.name: mp_death_drop_defuser
entries.description: Drop defuser on player death

entries.name: mp_death_drop_grenade
entries.description: Which grenade to drop on player death: 0=none, 1=best, 2=current or best, 3=all grenades

entries.name: mp_death_drop_gun
entries.description: Which gun to drop on player death: 0=none, 1=best, 2=current or best, 3=both

entries.name: mp_death_drop_healthshot
entries.description: Drop healthshot on player death

entries.name: mp_death_drop_taser
entries.description: Drop taser on player death

entries.name: mp_deathcam_skippable
entries.description: Determines whether a player can early-out of the deathcam.

entries.description: Prints time outs to the console for debugging

entries.description: If the map doesn't define an objective (bomb, hostage, etc), the value of this convar will declare the winner when the time runs out in the round.

entries.name: mp_defuser_allocation
entries.description: How to allocate defusers to CTs at start or round: 0=none, 1=random, 2=everyone

entries.name: mp_disable_autokick
entries.description: Prevents a userid from being auto-kicked

entries.description: When a bot disconnects, kill them first.  Requires mp_disconnect_kills_players.

entries.name: mp_disconnect_kills_players
entries.description: When a player disconnects, kill them first (triggering item drops, stats, etc.)

entries.name: mp_display_kill_assists
entries.description: Whether to display and score player assists

entries.name: mp_dm_bonus_length_max
entries.description: Maximum time the bonus time will last (in seconds)

entries.name: mp_dm_bonus_length_min
entries.description: Minimum time the bonus time will last (in seconds)

entries.name: mp_dm_bonus_percent
entries.description: Percent of points additionally awarded when someone gets a kill with the bonus weapon during the bonus period.

entries.name: mp_dm_bonusweapon_dogtags
entries.description: Additional dogtags to drop when making a kill with the bonus weapon

entries.name: mp_dm_dogtag_score
entries.description: Points to award for picking up a dogtag in deathmatch.

entries.description: Grant healthshots in deathmatch after n kills

entries.description: Number of base points to award for a kill in deathmatch.  Cheaper weapons award 1 or 2 additional points.

entries.name: mp_dm_taser_bonus_streak_max
entries.description: Maximum times to multiply the score for getting a streak of taser kills in a single life.

entries.name: mp_dm_teammode
entries.description: In deathmatch, enables team DM visuals & scoring (0: personal, 1: team mode, 2: use team contribution score)

entries.name: mp_dm_teammode_bonus_score
entries.description: Team deathmatch victory points to award for kill with bonus weapon

entries.name: mp_dm_teammode_dogtag_score
entries.description: Team deathmatch victory points to award for collecting enemy dogtags

entries.name: mp_dm_teammode_kill_score
entries.description: Team deathmatch victory points to award for enemy kill

entries.name: mp_dm_time_between_bonus_min
entries.description: Minimum time a bonus time will start after the round start or after the last bonus (in seconds)

entries.name: mp_dogtag_despawn_on_killer_death
entries.description: Whether dogtags should despawn when their killer dies

entries.description: How many seconds dogtags should stay around before despawning automatically (0 = infinite)

entries.name: mp_dogtag_pickup_rule
entries.description: Who is eligible to pick up a dogtag (0 = killer only, 1 = killer's team, 2 = victim's team, 3 = killer & victim's team, 4 = anyone)

entries.name: mp_drop_grenade_enable
entries.description: Allows players to drop grenades.

entries.name: mp_drop_knife_enable
entries.description: Allows players to drop knives.

entries.name: mp_dump_timers
entries.description: Prints round timers to the console for debugging

entries.name: mp_economy_reset_rounds
entries.description: Reset all player money every N rounds (0 for never)

entries.name: mp_endmatch_votenextleveltime
entries.description: If mp_endmatch_votenextmap is set, players have this much time to vote on the next map at match end.

entries.name: mp_endmatch_votenextmap
entries.description: Whether or not players vote for the next map at the end of the match when the final scoreboard comes up

entries.name: mp_endmatch_votenextmap_keepcurrent
entries.description: If set, keeps the current map in the list of voting options.  If not set, the current map will not appear in the list of voting options.

entries.description: Modes available for endmatch voting during War Games. Separate names with spaces.

entries.description: Maximum number of maps to include in endmatch voting during War Games

entries.name: mp_endmatch_votenextmap_wargames_nummodes
entries.description: Maximum number of other War Games to include in endmatch voting during War Games

entries.name: mp_endwarmup_player_count
entries.description: Number of players required to be connected to end warmup early. 0 to require maximum players for mode.

entries.name: mp_equipment_reset_rounds
entries.description: Reset all player equipment every N rounds (0 for never)

entries.name: mp_fadetoblack
entries.description: fade a player's screen to black when he dies

entries.name: mp_flinch_punch_scale
entries.description: Scalar for first person view punch when getting hit.

entries.name: mp_footsteps_serverside
entries.description: Makes the server always play footstep sounds. Clients never calculate footstep sounds locally, instead relying on the server.

entries.name: mp_force_pick_time
entries.description: The amount of time a player has on the team screen to make a selection before being auto-teamed

entries.name: mp_forcecamera
entries.description: Restricts spectator modes for dead players

entries.name: mp_free_armor
entries.description: Determines whether kevlar (1+) and/or helmet (2+) are given automatically.

entries.name: mp_freezetime
entries.description: how many seconds to keep players frozen when the round starts

entries.name: mp_friendlyfire
entries.description: Allows team members to injure other members of their team

entries.name: mp_give_player_c4
entries.description: Whether this map should spawn a c4 bomb for a player or not.

entries.name: mp_global_damage_per_second
entries.description: If above 0, deal non-lethal damage to players over time.

entries.name: mp_guardian_bomb_plant_custom_x_mark_location
entries.description: x,y,z to display an X for the bomb plant in guardian missions with custom bomb plant boundaries.

entries.name: mp_guardian_target_site
entries.description: If set to the index of a bombsite, will cause random spawns to be only created near that site.

entries.name: mp_halftime
entries.description: Determines whether the match switches sides in a halftime event.

entries.name: mp_halftime_duration
entries.description: Target number of seconds that halftime lasts; shortened if team intros are active

entries.name: mp_halftime_pausematch
entries.description: Set to 1 to pause match after halftime countdown elapses. Match must be resumed by vote or admin.

entries.name: mp_halftime_pausetimer
entries.description: Set to 1 to stay in halftime indefinitely. Set to 0 to resume the timer.

entries.name: mp_hostages_max
entries.description: Maximum number of hostages to spawn.

entries.name: mp_hostages_rescuetime
entries.description: Additional time added to round time if a hostage is reached by a CT.

entries.name: mp_hostages_rescuetowin
entries.description: 0 == all alive, any other number is the number the CT's need to rescue to win the round.

entries.name: mp_hostages_run_speed_modifier
entries.description: Default is 1.0, slow down hostages by setting this to < 1.0.

entries.name: mp_hostages_spawn_farthest
entries.description: When enabled will consistently force the farthest hostages to spawn.

entries.name: mp_hostages_spawn_force_positions
entries.description: Comma separated list of zero based indices to force spawn positions, e.g. '0,2' or '1,6'

entries.name: mp_hostages_spawn_force_positions_xyz
entries.description: Comma separated list of xyz locations to force spawn positions, e.g. 'x1 y1 z1,x2 y2 z2'

entries.name: mp_hostages_spawn_same_every_round
entries.description: 0 = spawn hostages randomly every round, 1 = same spawns for entire match.

entries.name: mp_hostages_takedamage
entries.description: Whether or not hostages can be hurt.

entries.description: Restricts human players to a single team {any, CT, T}

entries.description: Logs attacks.  Values are: 0=off, 1=enemy, 2=teammate, 3=both)

entries.name: mp_logdetail_items
entries.description: Logs a line any time a player acquires or loses an item.

entries.name: mp_logmoney
entries.description: Enables money logging.  Values are: 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: mp_match_can_clinch
entries.description: Can a team clinch and end the match by being so far ahead that the other team has no way to catching up?

entries.name: mp_match_end_changelevel
entries.description: At the end of the match, perform a changelevel even if next map is the same

entries.name: mp_match_end_restart
entries.description: At the end of the match, perform a restart instead of loading a new map

entries.name: mp_match_restart_delay
entries.description: Time (in seconds) until a match restarts.

entries.name: mp_max_armor
entries.description: Determines the highest level of armor allowed to be purchased. (0) None, (1) Kevlar, (2) Helmet

entries.name: mp_maxmoney
entries.description: maximum amount of money allowed in a player's account

entries.name: mp_maxrounds
entries.description: max number of rounds to play before server changes maps

entries.name: mp_min_halftime_duration
entries.description: Minimum number of seconds that halftime lasts even if team intros are active

entries.name: mp_modify_timeouts
entries.description: mp_modify_timeouts <CT|T> <N>, e.g., mp_modify ct -1

entries.description: When overtime is enabled, only so many overtimes can be played

entries.name: mp_overtime_maxrounds
entries.description: When overtime is enabled play additional rounds to determine winner

entries.description: T Loadouts for upgraded pistol round when playing bomb site retake.

entries.name: phys_list
entries.description:
List all physics component contents of every entity in the game;
-stream [1|0]         initiate|terminate streaming to physics debugger
-allents              include non-physical entities
-classes              print class names
-sdk                  Rubikon-wide memory short status
-sdk -struct          Rubikon-wide memory use per struct
-sdk -rebuildsvms     Rubikon-wide SVM force rebuild and status
-world                current state of the world
-world -touch         list body pairs (bodies in contact)
-world -save <name>   save world to a file
-world -mem           memory dump (separately per game dll)
-world -snapshots     Start/Stop dumping snapshots of the world into the current directory
-world -agg           current aggregate data registry (loaded resources)

entries.description: The percentage of overlapping attempts in the attempt window below which input automation detection is triggered at the success threshold.

entries.name: sv_auto_cstrafe_min_attempts
entries.description: The minimum number of counter-strafe attempts required for input automation detection. The player must be moving more than 135.2 units/s for their counter-strafe to be considered an attempt. An attempt is either considered a success (counter-strafing took place within a single tick), an overlap (both directions were held for 1+ ticks) or an underlap (neither direction was held for 1+ ticks).

entries.name: sv_auto_cstrafe_sequence_length
entries.description: The length of sequential counter-strafe attempts evaluated relative to the success threshold. Input automation detection considers the best sequence within the larger attempt window.

entries.name: sv_auto_cstrafe_success_threshold
entries.description: The minimum number of successful counter-strafes within a best sequence that will trigger input automation detection. The number of successes that trigger input automation detection is interpolated between the success threshold and a 'perfect' sequence (all counter-strafes in a sequence are successes), depending on the player's percentage of overlapping counter-strafe attempts.

entries.name: sv_auto_cstrafe_upper_overlap_pct_threshold
entries.description: The percentage of overlapping attempts in the attempt window below which input automation detection is triggered when all counter-strafes in a sequence are successes.
